pronunciation_note: Pure sound only, e.g. 'j-j-j' not 'juh' — keep it short and bouncy, no vowel on the end.
mnemonic: Jem the ladybird jiggles and jumps, j-j-j, every time she lands on a leaf.

character.name: Jem
character.blurb: Jem is a small ladybird who can't stand still — she jiggles her wings before every little jump.

formation_cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down below the line and curl round to the left. Finish below the line. Lift, and add a dot above.
action: Give two quick jiggling jumps on the spot, elbows tucked in, saying j-j-j as you land each time.

pronunciation_note: A buzzy, continuous sound — top teeth rest gently on bottom lip and you can hold it, 'vvvv', don't add 'uh'.
mnemonic: Vela the vole feels her whiskers vibrate, vvv, whenever she trundles her tiny cart of seeds.

character.name: Vela
character.blurb: Vela is a round little hedgehog who pulls a cart everywhere, whiskers buzzing as the wheels turn.

formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point on the line, then slant up to the right. Finish at the top right.
action: Rest two fingers lightly on your chin and let them 'buzz' while you hum vvv.

pronunciation_note: Round your lips into a small circle before you start, then open them as you say 'w' — quick and rounded, not stretched.
mnemonic: Willow the wren wobbles side to side along her branch, w-w-w, before she takes off.

character.name: Willow
character.blurb: Willow is a small wren who never flies straight off — she wobbles a wiggly little dance on the branch first.

formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point, up to the middle, down to a second point, then up. Finish at the top right.
action: Round your lips into a circle, sway your shoulders side to side twice, then say w-w-w.

pronunciation_note: This is two sounds squashed together, 'k' then 's' — say them fast, one after the other: ks.
mnemonic: Xander the fox crosses his front paws, ks-ks, when he's about to pounce.

character.name: Xander
character.blurb: Xander is a cheeky little creature who always crosses his paws over each other before he moves.

formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, crossing the first line. Finish on the line.
action: Cross your arms in front of your chest like an X while saying ks-ks.

pronunciation_note: A quick sound made at the front of the mouth, 'y-y-y' — don't turn it into 'yuh'.
mnemonic: Yolanda the young duckling yawns and yelps, y-y-y, first thing every morning by the pond.

character.name: Yolanda
character.blurb: Yolanda is the youngest duckling in her family and always the first one awake, calling out to everyone else.

formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right, to the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, through the first line and on below it. Finish below the line.
action: Cup your hands round your mouth like a little beak and call out y-y-y.

pronunciation_note: A buzzing sound you can hold, 'zzzz' — feel it tickle your lips, don't add 'uh' on the end.
mnemonic: Zinnia the bee zigzags between the flowers, zzz, never flying in a straight line.

character.name: Zinnia
character.blurb: Zinnia is a busy little bee who always flies in quick zigzags instead of a straight path.

formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Go straight across to the right, slant down to the bottom left, then straight across to the right. Finish at the bottom right.
action: Trace a zigzag in the air with one finger while buzzing zzz.

pronunciation_note: Still just one buzzing 'zzzz' sound even though it's written with two letters — hold it, don't say it twice.
mnemonic: When Zinnia the bee gets excited she buzzes extra loud, zzzz, wings a blur.

character.name: Zinnia
character.blurb: Zinnia doubles her buzz when she's excited — one zigzag wing-beat just isn't enough.

formation_cue: Write 'z' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Shake both hands fast by your ears like buzzing wings and hold zzzz.

pronunciation_note: Two sounds squashed together, 'k' then 'w' — say them fast as one: kw. These two letters are never split up.
mnemonic: Quinn the quail quivers her tail feathers, kw-kw, whenever she's asking a question.

character.name: Quinn
character.blurb: Quinn is a curious little bird who quivers her tail whenever something puzzles her.

formation_cue: Write 'q': start at the top right of a small round shape, curve round to the left and back up, then pull straight down below the line and finish there. Then write 'u' close beside it. 'q' is always followed by 'u'.
action: Tilt your head to one side like you're puzzled and give a little shiver, saying kw-kw.

pronunciation_note: One quick sound made together, 'ch' — like a small sneeze, don't say 'c' and 'h' apart.
mnemonic: Chip the squirrel chomps his acorn in one quick bite, ch-ch, cheeks full.

character.name: Chip
character.blurb: Chip isn't a squirrel himself but the acorn he guards — he squeaks a sharp ch-ch whenever anyone tries to chomp him.

formation_cue: Write 'c', then 'h', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Snap your fingers once close to your mouth like a quick chomp, saying ch-ch.

pronunciation_note: A soft, quiet sound you can hold, 'shhh' — like asking for quiet, no vowel added on the end.
mnemonic: Shelly the snail slides into her shell and whispers shhh when the garden gets too noisy.

character.name: Shelly
character.blurb: Shelly is a shy snail who tucks into her shell and hushes everyone with a soft shhh.

formation_cue: Write 's', then 'h', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Hold one finger up to your lips and whisper shhh.

pronunciation_note: Pop your tongue tip gently between your teeth and blow, 'th' — it can sound soft (thin) or buzzy (that), practise both.
mnemonic: Theo the tortoise pokes his tongue out just a little, th-th, whenever he's thinking hard.

character.name: Theo
character.blurb: Theo isn't a tortoise but a slow, thoughtful mushroom who pokes a little tongue-shaped frill out when he's puzzling something over.

formation_cue: Write 't', then 'h', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Poke your tongue tip gently between your teeth and blow softly, th-th.

pronunciation_note: A hum made at the back of the mouth, 'ng' — like the end of 'sing', hold it and feel your nose buzz slightly.
mnemonic: Nigel the nest hums a long, low ng-ng note that wobbles the twigs around him.

character.name: Nigel
character.blurb: Nigel is a cosy nest that hums a low ng note whenever the wind rocks him gently.

formation_cue: Write 'n', then 'g', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Hum ng-ng with your mouth slightly open and the back of your tongue raised, and tap your nose gently to feel it buzz.

pronunciation_note: A long, gliding sound, 'ai' as in 'rain' — let it stretch, it slides from one shape to another.
mnemonic: Acorn Ada waits under the leaf, chin up, whenever the first raindrop of a shower slides down, ai-ai.

character.name: Ada
character.blurb: Ada is a patient little acorn who tips her cap up to catch the first drops of rain.

formation_cue: Write 'a', then 'i', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Tip your chin up and trace one finger sliding down through the air like a raindrop, saying ai-ai.

pronunciation_note: A long, stretched sound, 'ee' as in 'tree' — smile as you say it and hold it for a full breath.
mnemonic: Ellie the owl stretches up tall on her branch to see far and wide, ee-ee.

character.name: Ellie
character.blurb: Ellie is a curious owl who stretches her neck up long and tall whenever she's trying to see something far away.

formation_cue: Write 'e' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Stretch your neck up tall, hands framing wide eyes, and hold ee-ee for a full breath.

pronunciation_note: A long gliding sound, 'igh' as in 'night' — three letters, one sound, glide from a wide mouth to a smile.
mnemonic: Isla the owl blinks her big eyes wide open at night, igh-igh, when the sky turns dark.

character.name: Isla
character.blurb: Isla is a night-time owl whose eyes go extra wide and round as soon as the sky darkens.

formation_cue: Write 'i', then 'g', then 'h', close together — three letters, one sound.
action: Open your eyes wide like an owl and glide one hand upward through the air, saying igh-igh.

pronunciation_note: A long, rounded sound, 'oa' as in 'boat' — round your lips into an O shape and let it glide.
mnemonic: Otto the duckling floats along, round and steady, oa-oa, wherever the pond takes him.

character.name: Otto
character.blurb: Otto is a calm little duckling who floats in a slow, steady circle no matter how choppy the pond gets.

formation_cue: Write 'o', then 'a', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Round your lips into an O, rock gently side to side like floating, and say oa-oa.

pronunciation_note: A long, deep sound, 'oo' as in 'moon' — round your lips small and hold it, this is the LONG version of oo.
mnemonic: Luna the owl hoots a long, deep call across the moonlit garden, oo-oo.

character.name: Luna
character.blurb: Luna only hoots at night, a long deep oo-oo call that carries right across the garden.

formation_cue: Write 'o' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Cup your hands around your mouth and hoot a long, low oo-oo.

pronunciation_note: A short, light sound, 'oo' as in 'book' — quick and soft, this is the SHORT version, different from the long 'oo' in 'moon'. The two 'oo' sounds are easy to mix up: one holds long (moon), this one is quick and clipped (book).
mnemonic: Bobbin the hedgehog gives a quick, soft puff, oo-oo, when he's pushing a heavy pinecone.

character.name: Bobbin
character.blurb: Bobbin is a small, huffing hedgehog who gives short, quick puffs whenever he's pushing something heavy.

formation_cue: Write 'o' twice, close together, just like the long 'oo' — the letters are exactly the same, only the sound is different.
action: Give a quick, soft puff of breath, oo-oo, like you're pushing something heavy just twice.

pronunciation_note: A long, open sound, 'ar' as in 'car' — open your mouth wide and let it drop back, hold it for a moment.
mnemonic: Arlo the fox opens his mouth wide and lets out a long, low ar-ar under the starry sky.

character.name: Arlo
character.blurb: Arlo is a bright evening star who lets out a long, low twinkle-sound whenever the sky goes dark.

formation_cue: Write 'a', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Open your mouth wide, tip your head back to look at the sky, and hold ar-ar.

pronunciation_note: A long, rounded sound, 'or' as in 'for' — round your lips more than 'ar' and hold it steady.
mnemonic: Orin the owl rounds his beak into a small O and calls a long or-or before he swoops down.

character.name: Orin
character.blurb: Orin always rounds his beak into a tiny O shape and gives a long or-or call before he ever swoops.

formation_cue: Write 'o', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Round your lips into a small O, mime swooping one arm downward, and say or-or.

pronunciation_note: A long, low sound made in the middle of the mouth, 'ur' as in 'burn' — lips slightly rounded, hold it steady like a purr.
mnemonic: Ursula the hedgehog curls into a tight ball and hums a low, steady ur-ur while she rests.

character.name: Ursula
character.blurb: Ursula curls into a tight round ball whenever she's resting and hums a low, steady note.

formation_cue: Write 'u', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Hug your arms around yourself like curling into a ball and hum a low, steady ur-ur.

pronunciation_note: A loud, gliding sound, 'ow' as in 'cow' — start wide and glide down, like a little yelp of surprise.
mnemonic: Otis the owl flaps out and hoots a loud, surprised ow-ow when a branch wobbles under him.

character.name: Otis
character.blurb: Otis gives a startled ow-ow hoot whenever his branch wobbles unexpectedly beneath him.

formation_cue: Write 'o', then 'w', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Throw both arms out wide as if wobbling off balance and yelp ow-ow.

pronunciation_note: A short, sharp gliding sound, 'oi' as in 'coin' — start rounded and glide quickly to a smile, like calling out.
mnemonic: Oskar the caterpillar bumps into a shiny leaf and calls out a sharp oi-oi in surprise.

character.name: Oskar
character.blurb: Oskar bumps into things more than any other caterpillar and always calls out a sharp oi-oi.

formation_cue: Write 'o', then 'i', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Throw one hand up like calling out to a friend and say a sharp oi-oi.

pronunciation_note: A gliding sound, 'ear' as in 'hear' — start short and glide gently towards 'uh', like leaning in to listen.
mnemonic: Edie the sparrow leans in close and tilts her head, ear-ear, whenever a sound is far away.

character.name: Edie
character.blurb: Edie is a sharp-eared sparrow who tilts her head and leans in close to catch quiet, faraway sounds.

formation_cue: Write 'e', then 'a', then 'r', close together — three letters, one sound.
action: Cup a hand behind your ear and lean your head in gently, saying ear-ear.

pronunciation_note: A gliding sound, 'air' as in 'chair' — start open and glide gently towards 'uh', let your voice float.
mnemonic: Amara the feather drifts on the breeze, floating and swaying, air-air, before it lands.

character.name: Amara
character.blurb: Amara is a light feather who never falls straight down — she always drifts and sways on the air first.

formation_cue: Write 'a', then 'i', then 'r', close together — three letters, one sound.
action: Hold one hand up like a feather and let it drift side to side slowly through the air, saying air-air.

pronunciation_note: A gliding sound, 'ure' as in 'sure' — lips rounded to start, gliding gently towards 'uh', soft and short.
mnemonic: Ursa the snail tucks in sure and steady, ure-ure, whenever her shell feels safe and snug.

character.name: Ursa
character.blurb: Ursa only ever moves when she's sure it's safe, tucking snug into her shell with a soft ure-ure hum.

formation_cue: Write 'u', then 'r', then 'e', close together — three letters, one sound.
action: Wrap your arms around yourself in a snug hug and hum ure-ure.

pronunciation_note: 'er' as in 'her' and 'fern' — a steady sound like 'ur'. At the end of a longer word, as in 'hammer', it is lighter and quicker.
mnemonic: Ember the mushroom mutters a soft, quiet er-er whenever a raindrop taps her cap.

character.name: Ember
character.blurb: Ember is a quiet mushroom who only ever mutters her sound softly, never loudly, whenever it rains.

formation_cue: Write 'e', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
action: Shrug your shoulders lightly and mutter a soft, quick er-er.
